steps.text: Advertises AVX to the game through Rosetta. The one crash report on Highball (highball#80) is a page fault in the game's own code seconds after launch with AVX hidden, the shape a CPU-feature or anti-tamper check produces; CrossOver users run the game with AVX visible. If it still crashes with this on, say so on highball#80 with the new log.
DirectX 11, so DXMT. CrossOver users report the sound cutting out and an audio fix; not looked at here yet.

knownIssues.symptom: Crash within seconds of launch, page fault in the game's own code
